The main takeaway from our work is that
, when dealing with the intersection problem of a filled rectangle and ellipse, the quadratic nature of the latter can be exploited to devise an efficient intersection test.
, for this particular problem, the use of a polynomial to describe the ellipse is more advantageous than the use of a parametric equation.
